first_secret.text: Qian slides a counting bead across the table and coughs. "Do not mistake this for kindness. It is an investment." He taps the table. "Back Alleys, after dark. Ask for the lantern-hanger; he knows who is buying what."

teach_gold_piercing_finger.text: Qian taps one finger on your wrist, light as a coin. "One point. All your qi. A lock, a seal, a purse-string, {player}. Again."

qian_after.text: Qian's abacus clicks once. "I hear a certain purse-string came undone at your touch, {player}. I did not teach you that, naturally. For a fee, I never did."

qian_weekly.text: Qian slides a bead across. "Visit each week and I will show you where the market keeps its locks. One honest lesson, one honest deal. That is the price."

teach_hint.text: Qian smiles thinly. "A lesson has a price, and the price is trust. Bring me a few more honest deals first."

errand_done_thanks.text: Qian does not look up from the abacus. "Delivered, sealed, unread. Naturally. One bead for your trouble, {player}. Not a gift. A debt I mean to forget."

greet.text: Information is the only treasure that grows when shared, and the price grows with it. What do you want to know?

choices.label: Buy a rumour about Azure Peak. (20 stones)
Buy a map to a hidden spirit vein. (120 stones)
Sell him the Ancient Jade Slip. (+600 stones)
Ask about the Blood Lotus Sect.
Ask about the finger he taps on his abacus.
Tell him the golden finger has paid for itself.
Ask if he would drill you on the finger again.
Ask if he would drill you on the finger again.
Tell him the ledger is delivered.
Ask what he would sell you for free.

peak.text: A cave on the peak holds a dead cultivator's legacy. A stone guardian watches it. Do not go before Foundation Establishment.

vein.text: Two days north-west. Absorb it quickly; such veins scatter within a season.

slip.text: A pleasure doing business. Don't tell anyone where you sold it.

blood_lotus.text: You've the right look for them. They recruit anyone at the Sect Envoy Hall, cultivation or not. Strength is all they respect.
